title: ranunculus aquatilis subsp. rhipiphyllus
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. rhipiphyllus, commonly known as Water Buttercup, is a perennial aquatic plant native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. rhipiphyllus include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms, and its diuretic properties, which aid in the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
